rename.to: All runner packages should set developmentDependency=true

issue.title: dnu pack should pass developmentDependency from project.json into the .nuspec file
issue.body:
The DNX runner (among other things) should be considered a development dependency in NuGet terms. This is a valid value in the .nuspec file as of NuGet 2.8, but project.json doesn't seem to respect it or pass it through into the generated .nuspec file.

Related: xunit/xunit#667

body: Note: I made the change to the DNX runner's project.json, but it doesn't appear to actually pass that value into the NUSPEC file as-of yet. I opened a bug in DNX, but given the lateness of the development cycle, bets are off as to whether it gets fixed or not.

You use DNX to build your xunit.runner.console package?
Hmmm... I'll add this to my list of reasons to continue avoiding DNX.
I don't, and I don't know why you think I do.

> Note: I made the change to the DNX runner's project.json, but it doesn't appear to actually pass that value into the NUSPEC file as-of yet.

That sounds like you added the attribute to a project.json file instead of directly to your .nuspec file. The only reason I can imagine you'd do that is if you didn't have a .nuspec file, and the DNX you mentioned produced it from your project.json file. So it was a bit of deduction. 

If you're not using DNX, why would you open a bug against DNX? What does that have to do with the xunit.runner.console package?

There are four runners affected by this: Console, MSBuild, Visual Studio, and DNX. That's why there are three referenced commits.

The console runner is not built by DNX; the DNX runner is.

issue.title: xunit.analyzers package should be marked as a developmentDependency

repository.name: xunit
repository.description: xUnit.net is a free, open source, community-focused unit testing tool for .NET.

issue.body:
The xunit.analyzers NuGet package should be marked with `<developmentDependency>true</developmentDependency>`.

Similar to #667. And all other analyzer-only NuGet packages that I know also have this set.
